### **Read in Files**

```{r class_df}
model_env <- new.env()
load(model_path, envir = model_env)
classes <- model_env$classes
model <- model_env$final_model
filtered_mz <- model_env$filtered_mz
normalization_method <- model_env$normalization_method
best_threshold <- model_env$best_threshold
background_file <- model_env$background_file
ppm_error <- model_env$ppm_error
mass_range <- model_env$mass_range
SNR_thresh <- model_env$SNR_thresh
cube_root <- model_env$cube_root

#load(model_path)
class_df <- pull_classes(sample_dir)
class_df <- class_df %>%
  rename(Gram = V11, Species = V12, Subtype = V13, Sample = V14)

class_df <- class_df %>%
  filter(Gram != "Polymicrobial_gram-positive-and-negative") %>%
  na.omit()

spec <- process_ms_files(sample_dir, ppm = ppm_error, mass_range = mass_range)
```

``` {r peak alignment to pan-cancer training peaks}
## These are dummy parameters here to match up with training model. Do not change
features <- data.frame(
  mean_mz = filtered_mz, 
  min = rnd_sigfigs(filtered_mz - filtered_mz * ppm_error/1e+06, ppm_error, type = "numeric"), 
  max = rnd_sigfigs(filtered_mz + filtered_mz * ppm_error/1e+06, ppm_error, type = "numeric")
  )
feature_mean_or_median <- "mean"

aligned_spectra <- bin_spectra(spectra_list = spec, features, type = feature_mean_or_median, class_df = class_df)

## Add missing m/z's to match colnames of training matrix
train_mz <- round(as.numeric(filtered_mz), 4)
test_mz  <- round(as.numeric(colnames(aligned_spectra)), 4)
missing_mz <- setdiff(train_mz, test_mz)
for (mz in missing_mz) {
  aligned_spectra[[as.character(mz)]] <- 0
}
## Reorder to match training
aligned_spectra <- aligned_spectra[, match(train_mz, round(as.numeric(colnames(aligned_spectra)), 4)), drop = FALSE]
```

```{r yall}
yall <- factor(class_df$Gram)
```

```{r normalization}
xall <- normalize_pixel(as.matrix(aligned_spectra), normalization_method)
if (cube_root) xall <- xall^(1/3)
```

```{r Testing}
dxall <- xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(xall))

pred_prob <- predict(model, dxall)
```

``` {r test confusion matrix}
test_p_thresh <- ifelse(pred_prob < best_threshold, classes[1], classes[2])
test_p_class  <- factor(test_p_thresh, levels(yall))

test_cm <- table(True = yall, Predict = test_p_class)
```

``` {r test histogram}
test_df <- data.frame(file_name        = class_df$Sample,
                      true_class       = yall,
                      prediction_class = test_p_class,
                      probability      = as.numeric(pred_prob))

rownames(test_df) <- NULL

test_wrong_preds <- test_df %>%
  filter(true_class != prediction_class)
```

```{r save files, include = FALSE}
## test set files
write.csv(test_cm, 
          file = file.path(files_dir, "test_cm.csv"))

write.csv(test_df, 
          row.names = FALSE,
          file.path(files_dir, "test_preds.csv"))

write.csv(test_wrong_preds, 
          row.names = FALSE,
          file.path(files_dir, "mis_preds.csv"))
```

#### **Preprocessing and Statistical Model Settings**

```{r chunk3, fig.align = "center"}
model_version <- sapply(str_split(model_path,"/"), tail, 1)

settings_df <- rbind(c("SNR Threshold:", SNR_thresh),
                     c("Mass Range:", paste0('<i>m/z</i> ', mass_range[1], " - ", mass_range[2])),
                     c("Normalization Method:", normalization_method),
                     c("Model Version:", model_version))

classes2 <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", classes))
#classes2 <- unlist(lapply(str_split(classes, pattern  = " "), tail, n = 1L)) ## If class is last element of full class name
#classes2 <- unlist(lapply(str_split(classes, pattern  = "_"), tail, n = 1L)) ## If class is last element of full class name

kable(settings_df,
      row.names = FALSE,
      align = "l",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      longtable = TRUE,
      full_width = FALSE,
      linesep = "")%>%
  column_spec(1:2, width = "3in")%>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = F)

cols <- c(hue_pal()(2))
```

```{r chunk4}
test_cm <- as.data.frame.matrix(test_cm)
test_cm <- cbind(c("True", "True"),
                 classes2,
                 test_cm)
rownames(test_cm) <- NULL
colnames(test_cm) <- c(".", "  ", classes2)
names(test_cm)[1] <- cell_spec(names(test_cm)[1], color = "white")
test_accuracy <- rbind(c(paste0(classes2[1], " Recall: "), 
                         paste0(format(round((test_cm[1,3]/rowSums(test_cm[,3:4])[1])*100, 1), nsmall = 1), "%")),
                       c(paste0(classes2[2], " Recall: "), 
                         paste0(format(round((test_cm[2,4]/rowSums(test_cm[,3:4])[2])*100,1), nsmall = 1), "%")),
                       c("Overall Accuracy: ", 
                         paste0(format(round(((test_cm[1,3] + test_cm[2,4])/sum(test_cm[, 3:4]))*100, 1), nsmall = 1), "%")))
```

#### **Test Set Confusion Matrix**

```{r chunk7, fig.align = "center"}
kable(test_cm,
      align = "c",
      format = "html",
      escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  add_header_above(c("", " ", "Predict" = 2)) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(2, bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(2:4, width = "2cm") %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1) %>%
  column_spec(3, background = "#c3fcb5")

kable(test_accuracy,
      row.names = FALSE,
      align = "r") %>% 
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  kable_minimal(full_width = FALSE,
                bootstrap_options = "condensed",
                html_font = "Calibri",
                font_size = 16)
```

```{r chunk9, fig.width=8, fig.height=3, fig.align = "center"}
test_plot <- ggplot(test_df, aes(x=probability, fill=true_class, color=true_class)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth=0.01, alpha=0.25, position="identity",boundary=0) + 
  ggtitle("Model Prediction Probabilities: Test Set") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_threshold, linewidth = 0.75,  color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), minor_breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05), expand = c(0.05,0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rev(cols), labels = c(classes2[1], classes2[2])) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(cols), labels = c(classes2[1], classes2[2])) +
  labs(x = "Prediction Probability", y = "Spectra Count", color="True Class", fill = "True Class") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r chunk10}
## Add misclassified test samples
test_wrong_preds <- test_df %>%
  filter(true_class != prediction_class)

test_wrong_preds <- test_wrong_preds[order(test_wrong_preds$true_class), ]

test_wrong_preds$true_class <- gsub(classes[1], classes2[1], gsub(classes[2], classes2[2],test_wrong_preds$true_class))
test_wrong_preds$prediction_class <- gsub(classes[1], classes2[1], gsub(classes[2], classes2[2],test_wrong_preds$prediction_class))

test_wrong_preds$probability <- round(test_wrong_preds$probability, 3)
```
